The application uses a component-based architecture with reusable UI components.

Component Structure

Components are organized in the components/ directory:

  • UI Components (components/ui/): Base UI components built on Radix UI

  • Feature Components: Application-specific components

All components are written in TypeScript and use React hooks for state management.
